Omnia 251, Ornate Door Lever Latchset

Fit for royalty, door lever features luxurious embellishments on the handle and the rose. This latchset is not for people who want to make a simple statement—it exudes richness that will lend its ornate styling well to fancier home décors.

All critical interior parts are made of brass. Tough, non-rusting materials are used throughout. All dimensions are standard to fit existing bores for easy replacement installations.

Features of the Embellished Lever:

  • Meets ADA accessibility requirements.
  • 28 degrees rotation to retract latch.
  • Concealed screw rose covers 2-1/8" bore hole.
  • Solid Brass Construction

Specifications for Omnia 251 Fancy Door Lever:

  • Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8", 1-3/4", or 2"
  • Backset: either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Available Functions for Omnia 251/00 Solid Brass Ornate Door Lever:

  • Single Dummy: A stationary lever for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Includes 1 lever, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Double Dummy: A stationary lever for use as a pull or to match trim on both sides of door. Includes 2 levers, 2 roses, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door by using a 7mm solid spindle. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy and retract latchbolt. Uses 7mm split spindle. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

The Omnia Max-Brass Finish will change the way you think about finishes. The unique process in the manufacturing provides a superior resistance to tarnish or potting. Max Brass is a PVD polished brass coating that is highly resistant to extreme elements. It has a Lifetime No-Tarnish Guarantee. Recommended for harsh environments such as salty air.
